actual: Approved Phase 2 design requires direct L1 HMM observations built from PIT L2 daily data for both legacy 7-feature and autocycle 20-feature families, but it does not define per-feature L2-to-L1 aggregation or recomputation formulas, weights, missing-data behavior, or causal constituent changes. Existing trainer only implements a different 2-state 4-feature subset with fallback/skip behavior, so implementation cannot preserve approved semantics without an explicit contract. Fix must define exact versioned aggregation for all 20 fields, PIT weighting and missingness, then add distinguishing tests; no legacy fallback or posterior aggregation.
